name: animated-counter
useFor: Use for counts that change in place: parcels screened, requirements met. `animation="count"` (default) counts in 0.4s on a quint ease-out; `animation="roll"` rolls each digit on a spring with no bounce. The first render is still; under reduced motion the number swaps at once.
constraints: Animating a number on first render
Counters on values the person types
source: Not in Figma; motion follows the system's ease-out
title: Animated counter
description: A number that animates to its new value: counting through every value, or rolling each digit.
